name: Westsail 32
notes: All points are pixels in the 671x1281 greyscale drawing, read by hand off gridded enlargements and snapped to dark pixels where a column or row scan found the line. Bow is to the right in every view.
The drawing stacks three views: sail-plan profile on top (waterline y 786), inboard profile in the middle, accommodation plan at the bottom. Only the sail-plan profile and the plan are traced.

Profile hull, sternpost head at the sheer (x 48) to stem head (x 561), spans 513 px for an LOA of 32.0 ft, 16.03 px/ft. The outboard rudder's trailing edge (x 39.5) sits aft of the sternpost head and is not part of LOA; the bowsprit (to x 657) and boomkin (to x 11) are excluded too.

Calibrated on the hull: draft 4.77 ft (spec 5.0), waterline length sternpost to stem 27.1 ft (spec 27.5), 29.2 ft if measured to the rudder's trailing edge, beam 11.1 ft (spec 11.0), sparred length boomkin tip to bowsprit tip 40.3 ft. The rudder is the hull polygon's aft-most point, so profile.loaFromX names the sternpost head and stem head as the LOA ends; the polygon's extent (522 px, 16.3 px/ft) would read everything about 2% small.

The profile draws two longitudinal lines at the deck. The lower one, rising from 741 amidships to the sternpost head and the stem head, is traced as the sheer: it is the only one continuous from stern to stem, and gives about 4.8 ft freeboard at the stem and 2.9 ft amidships. The upper one, 10 to 13 px (0.6 to 0.8 ft) higher from about x 75 to x 525, reads as the bulwark caprail and is not in the hull polygon.

The rudder is hung on a sternpost raked about 24 degrees from vertical; the hull polygon follows the keel aft to its heel at x 122, then the rudder's foot, trailing edge and head (which stands above the sheer to take the tiller) back to the sternpost head.

The plan is drawn at the profile's scale but shifted: its stern point is at plan x 59 and its bow point at plan x 569 (510 px). Half-breadth x values are mapped onto the profile by those two common points, profile x = 48 + (plan x - 59) * 513/510; half-breadths are left in drawing pixels (0.6% scale difference). Plan centreline y 1168, half-breadth the mean of the two sides.
Nothing in the plan is inferred: the deck outline is drawn closed at both ends, so inferredFromX is set at the stem head.
The mast is drawn stepped on the coachroof at x 358 and raked aft about 1.4 degrees. The inner forestay leaves the mast at the spreader, y 219. The boom gallows at x 66 to 73 is not traced.
